source_excerpts.text:
ENTIRE POLYNOMIAL FACES FROM CUBIC ACOUSTIC RIGIDITY
30 October 2026. Principal derivation and exact internal symbolic receiver.

MAIN RESULT

For A=(a,b;c,d), write T=|A|^2, D=det A, and define

                 F_s=T^2-4s TD+(6s^2-2)D^2.

For EVERY REAL parameter

                    -1<s<1,  s != -1/3,1/3,                 (1)

F_s spans an exposed ray of the FULL 35-dimensional homogeneous quartic
rank-one-convex cone. In the FULL 70-dimensional space of polynomials of
degree <=4, the exposed face whose leading quartic is a nonnegative
multiple of F_s consists exactly of

       p(A)=c F_s(A+V)+Q(A)+L(A)+d, c>0,                   (2)

with Q any homogeneous rank-one-convex quadratic, V arbitrary, L linear,
and d constant, together with Q+L+d when the leading part is zero.
The parameters in (2) are unique. This entire face is common to the
rank-one-convex and quasiconvex cones, and has dimension 20 (14 modulo
affine functions and determinant).

There is NO symmetry restriction on p, V or Q. In particular this is
an ACTUAL classification of the lower quadratic boundary, including
degenerate quadratics, rather than the existence of a sufficiently
large positive multiple of T. For c>0 and 1/3<|s|<1, EVERY member is
non-polyconvex, whatever its finite lower-degree terms.

At s=+/-1/3 the cubic kernel has dimension EIGHT, not four. These
parameters are expressly excluded from (2). Their leading quartic rays
are still exposed, but their larger lower-degree problems are not
classified here. No whole-face conclusion at these parameters, at
the endpoints +/-1, or at the earlier 28-dimensional Hopf face is inferred.

The homogeneous QC primitive below is from Bruno--Pasqualotto,
arXiv:2608.06367v1, Appendix A. It is REPLAYED as a polynomial identity.
The full-space exposure, parameter-wide cubic rigidity and nonhomogeneous
face classification are the constructions made here. Historical priority
and external independent review are unestablished.

1. A GENERAL PRINCIPLE ABOUT CUBIC RIGIDITY

Let F be a nonzero QC homogeneous quartic on R^(2x2), exposed as a ray in
the full homogeneous ROC cone. Suppose its four derivatives are linearly
independent, and the cubics satisfying

for every acoustic pair rank R=1, F''(R)K=0, are precisely DF:V.
